title: 关系需求满足度 RNSS
author: Gregor Žvelc, Karolina Jovanoska & Maša Žvelc
notice: 本中文题目为依照正式论文英文题目所作的未验证翻译，未经过中文版心理测量验证。仅供娱乐和自我了解，不作诊断；不设临床分界值。本量表衡量一般人际关系中的需求满足，并非专门针对恋爱。按论文表2原题号；第18题按6减原分反向后，全量和各维度求均分，越高表示满足度越高。小机作答仅为娱乐演绎，不具有人类量表效度。
instruction: 请根据自身通常的实际情况，选择你对每句话的认同程度。原文仅命名量尺两端，中间档位保留数字。

items.text: 我的社交圈里有与我生活经历相似的人（例如有共同的爱好、职业，或属于同一个团体或网络论坛）。
items.original: My social circle consists of people who share a similar life experience to me (e.g., a hobby, a profession, belonging to the same group or online forum).

items.text: 和亲近的人相处时，我几乎不需要隐瞒什么。
items.original: I hardly have to hide anything in the company of people close to me.

items.text: 我的生活中有一个坚强、稳定且能保护我的人，让我可以依靠。
items.original: I have a strong, stable, and protective person in my life whom I can rely on.

items.text: 我认识一个有能力的人，在我遇到麻烦时会帮助我。
items.original: I know a capable individual who would help me if I found myself in trouble.

items.text: 我认识一些人，他们对某些事情的体验和我相似。
items.original: I know people who experience some things similarly to me.

items.text: 别人经常认真对待我的建议。
items.original: Others often take my advice to heart.

items.text: 即使我没有特别请求，别人也经常帮助我。
items.original: Other people often help me even if I do not specifically ask them to.

items.text: 我认识世界观和我相似的人。
items.original: I know people with a world-view similar to mine.

items.text: 别人有时会给我带来美好的惊喜。
items.original: Other people sometimes surprise me in a nice way.

items.text: 和我亲近的人有时不等我开口，就会为我做些事。
items.original: People close to me would sometimes do things for me without me having to ask.

items.text: 我可以自在地向别人表达感受、说出心里话，因为我知道他们接受真实的我。
items.original: I feel free to show my feelings to others and speak my mind because I know they accept me for who I am.

items.text: 在对我重要的人面前，我不必伪装自己。
items.original: I do not have to pretend with people who are important to me.

items.text: 我的生活中至少有一个人会鼓励我、保护我，或提供我需要的信息。
items.original: I have at least one person in my life who encourages me, protects me or provides me with the information I need.

items.text: 我的生活中有与我有相似经历的人。
items.original: There are people in my life with whom I share similar experiences.

items.text: 我觉得自己能对别人产生影响。
items.original: I feel that I have an influence on others.

items.text: 我可以在对我重要的人面前展现真实的自己，而不担心被拒绝。
items.original: I can show my true self to people who are important to me without fear of rejection.

items.text: 遇到麻烦时，有人会支持我，而且足够坚强，能够应对我的问题。
items.original: In times of trouble, I have someone who stands by me and who is strong enough to handle my problems.

items.text: 从来没有人为我准备美好的惊喜。
items.original: No-one ever prepares a nice surprise for me.

items.text: 我注意到别人有时会采纳我的建议。
items.original: I have noticed that other people sometimes follow my suggestions.

items.text: 别人经常询问我对某个话题的看法。
items.original: Other people often ask about my opinion on a certain topic.
